semantic.justification: S3HW1E HTML66: the original table-consumed non-CSS SetAnchorAndAdjustment overload now produces actual native anchor, horizontal/vertical orientation and wrap items, consuming real context/numbering margins, actual HasCurrentParaFlys and SwPaM movement. No-wrap admission queues original point spacing at the front, appends a real no-space paragraph and opens the original successor spacing override only for nonzero upper margin. Character anchoring moves to the previous Unicode character and restores the source point; inline nontext error retains the original already-written vertical item and absent anchor. Original InsertAttr point/head overloads share the existing owned HTMLAttr queue and source context heads. Existing GetULSpaceFromContext body moves unchanged into its original htmlcss1 source fragment to retain the strict parser size cap. Original Reader::ResetFrameFormatAttrs resets only LR/UL/box items. Real nonshareable SwFormatContent owns an optional registered SwNodeIndex, copies/clones independently, reuses engaged optional assignment, resets/destructs the index without owning its section, and compares actual node identity. Static RES_CNTNT105 defaults and pool registration use actual native items; typed GetContent lives on SwAttrSet/SwFormat. No fabricated serialized pointer, fly section/layout or measurement provider is introduced. These are complete consumed state/legacy-alignment source responsibility fragments, not completed first-cell/table production. CSS-positioned/container alignment, full Reader/reset-format families, MakeFlySection/content/contact/layout ownership, recursive HTML first-cell/table grammar/materialization/layout, RTF direction and final current-slice format/UI audit remain unported or unverified. General style-rename migration remains WRITER347; intentional save/open/autosave/recovery deviations stay unchanged. Whole-module/default/contract/desktop ABI parity is not certified.
